title: Migration 53 — batch COA extraction write
description: Applies migrations 24, 28 and 52 as prerequisites, then 53. VERIFY A checks the catalogue shape and that migration 52's single-row writer survives alongside the new batch one; B writes a four-row two-report pack in ONE call and proves the grouping and auth.uid() attribution hold; C is the reason the migration exists — a pack whose LAST element is refused by the table writes ZERO rows, where the per-row loop it replaces would have committed the first three; D-F prove the empty-array, unknown-key and per-call-ceiling refusals; G re-proves the admin gate including the session-less case a service-role connection presents; H re-proves migrations 28 and 52's constraints through the new door. Rollback drops both functions and asserts migration 52's writer is left intact.

verify.note: C is the headline: the failing element is admissible to the shape validator and refused by the table, so the failure occurs during the INSERT and proves the write is all-or-nothing rather than merely validated-first.
